Hooks must be exported, non-variadic, uniquely registered functions with one
context parameter first, followed by config pointers, and one error result.

-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- setup/setup.go --
package setup

import "context"

//fabrik:config log
type LogConfig struct {
	Level string `yaml:"level" default:"info"`
}

//fabrik:hook setup
func unexported(_ context.Context) error { return nil }

//fabrik:hook setup
func NoContext(c *LogConfig) error {
	_ = c
	return nil
}

//fabrik:hook setup
func NoError(_ context.Context) {}

//fabrik:hook setup
func TwoResults(_ context.Context) (int, error) { return 0, nil }

type myErr struct{}

func (myErr) Error() string { return "" }

//fabrik:hook setup
func DefinedError(_ context.Context) myErr { return myErr{} }

//fabrik:hook setup
func Variadic(_ context.Context, cs ...*LogConfig) error { return nil }

//fabrik:hook setup
func TwoContexts(_ context.Context, c2 context.Context) error {
	_ = c2
	return nil
}

// FakeContext has context.Context's shape but is not that type.
type FakeContext interface {
	Done() <-chan struct{}
	Err() error
}

//fabrik:hook setup
func LookAlike(_ FakeContext) error { return nil }

//fabrik:hook setup
//fabrik:hook setup
func Twice(_ context.Context) error { return nil }

//fabrik:hook setup
func Valid(ctx context.Context, c *LogConfig) error {
	_, _ = ctx, c
	return nil
}
-- web/web.go --
package web

import "net/http"

//fabrik:http GET /
func Index(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
